import json

data = json.loads(files)
entries = data.get("entries", [])

# Group by directory
from collections import defaultdict
dirs = {}
for e in entries:
    path = e["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
    parts = path.rsplit("/", 1)
    folder = parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 else "."
    if folder not in dirs:
        dirs[folder] = []
    dirs[folder].append({
        "name": e["name"],
        "size": e.get("size_bytes", 0),
        "is_dir": e.get("is_dir", False)
    })

total_files = len(entries)
print(f"Total entries: {total_files}\n")
for folder in sorted(dirs.keys()):
    print(f"📁 {folder}/")
    for f in sorted(dirs[folder], key=lambda x: x["name"]):
        icon = "📂" if f["is_dir"] else "📄"
        size_kb = f["size"] / 1024
        print(f"   {icon} {f['name']}  ({size_kb:.1f} KB)")
    print()
